title: Sign up to Receive 2 x $50 off Voucher for $300 Spend @ Samsung
body:
Deal: Sign up to Receive 2 x $50 off Voucher for $300 Spend @ Samsung

[Mattyjames] Can’t wait for them to raise the price then lower it back to original price and have us use our “free” vouchers to get a “discount”
[shxhshzhz] What prices are you referring to? E.g. many phones are not discounted and are full price now anyway
[Mattyjames] I’m just assuming that say if something was $1000 they will reduce it to $800 but since we’re getting $100 gift cards for “free” they will reduce that $1000 item to $900 which will cost us $800 when using the gift cards. In other words it was always going to be $800 either way
[shxhshzhz] In other words, you're just assuming without this imaginary scenario actually happening?
[Mattyjames] @shxhshzhz: Pretty much, I mean I’m not psychic and I do apologise for having an opinion
[shxhshzhz] @Mattyjames: No need to apologise. An opinion like that does not help anyone if it's not true for the deal
[DealHunted] Only yesterday placed an order for watch ultra 2 for $789, not sure if I should've waited another month or so.
[MajoraMiasmaGold] Samsung has been a joke. Every time a new mobile launch they’ve got the ridiculous rrp and 10 coupons that would reduce it to 50%.
Users would need to jump 10 hoops like a circus clown and begging friends gov email or fake a school boy with edu lol
[ntt] Or you can just buy an iPhone with barely a discount all year long
[FujinShu] Huh, I guess that’s why iphones depreciate at a slower rate than most android phones…
